description: Privacy question ('Voces guardam minhas mensagens?') -> intent=outside_channel -> fixed out-of-channel text, NO escalation, and NO claim about how the data is stored (J09 of the 01/10/2026 battery: classify-v5.1 answered `information` and the model said the messages are 'armazenadas de forma segura e pseudonimizada, seguindo as normas de privacidade' in 7 of 7 runs, with no basis in the repository: consent is not modelled and the retention matrix is a template). Synthetic data only.
